summary_markdown: The participants planned a demonstration of the current version of a campaign, tentatively scheduled for Wednesday next week. The focus will be on demonstrating the workflow across various status stages. It was confirmed that most statuses could be made read-only, pending a couple of days of preparation. Furthermore, it was noted that roles are configured within the system, although they currently have few functional differences. Separately, data missing for San Paulo is expected to be uploaded by Monday, as the client has provided the necessary information.
decisions: A demo of the campaign status workflow will take place next Wednesday.
action_items: Prepare statuses to be read-only (pending confirmation).
